messages:
incident-bot: Pager: streaming.sse.tail_p99 > 1.4s for service=streaming-gateway (region: ap-south). Paging #incidents :rotating_light:
Priya (oncall): I'm on it. Any initial customer reports?
Ethan Cole: seeing elevated SSE stall counts from proxy-south-01; logs show `chunk_queue_growth` and frequent 'slow-reader' marks.
Rina Das: Patchy pattern: most affected sessions come from a specific CDN edge (edge-34). Edge reports high retransmit. Could be network flakiness causing client backpressure.
Marco Silva: grab from proxy-south-01:
```
[2026-03-15T02:10:12Z] sse conn=conn-55 queued_chunks=12 queued_bytes=192K slow_reader=true
[2026-03-15T02:10:14Z] sse conn=conn-55 last_send=2026-03-15T02:08:50Z
[2026-03-15T02:10:32Z] sse conn=conn-71 queued_chunks=0 queued_bytes=0 slow_reader=false
```
support-bot: customers flagged: `media-platform-inc` (high error-rate), `chatly` (time-sensitive).
Priya (oncall): mitigation ideas?
Ethan Cole: immediate: 1) increase eviction of stalled streams to 30s 2) throttle per-connection write buffer to limit tail amplification 3) change routing to prefer proxies in the nearest AZ to edge-34.
Rina Das: prefer routing + throttle. Eviction alone might kick good clients if brief network hiccup.
Marco Silva: I'm for throttle + routing. Throttle config: `max_queued_bytes_per_conn=64k` and `write_backoff_base=50ms`
Priya (oncall): Assign: 
- Marco: apply throttle and restart proxy-south-01 (ETA 3m)
- Rina: apply routing change to avoid edge-34 (ETA 1m)
- Ethan: monitor p99 and `queued_chunks` metric; stand by to revert if regressions.
infra-bot: routing change deployed by Rina Das: edge-34 traffic moved to proxy-south-02.
Marco Silva: patching config now. `kubectl patch configmap/proxy-config -n prod --patch '{"data":{"max_queued_bytes_per_conn":"65536","write_backoff_base":"50ms"}}'` then restart selected pods.
infra-bot: restart triggered for deployment/streaming-proxy (selector=proxy-south-01).
Ethan Cole: metrics update: p99 dropped from 1600ms -> 700ms within 5 minutes. queued_chunks > threshold dropped 85%.
support-bot: Notified affected customers with troubleshooting steps: reduce client read window, enable keepalive pings.
Priya (oncall): Good. Add follow-ups: schedule a network diagnostics run with CDN owner for edge-34. Also add synthetic tests from edge-34 to validate stability.
Rina Das: will set up synthetic from edge-34 and add alert if `max_queued_bytes_per_conn` hits limit frequently.
Marco Silva: Opening ticket INFRA-9001 to track permanent mitigations: smarter per-connection throttling and early backpressure signal to clients.
Priya (oncall): Handoff notes: logs path `/var/log/streaming-proxy/*`, dashboards infra/streaming/sse_tail, mitigations: throttle + routing. I'll watch for 30m then handoff.
incident-bot: Incident severity SEV3. Postmortem requested.
Priya (oncall): Closing active page. If any regression, escalate to SEV2. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
